environment.description: Terraform provider artifact service deployed on EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic directly to the service on port 8443. No additional request inspection or filtering is configured. The service runs as root in a Docker container with the host filesystem mounted at /var/lib/terraform-provider-artifacts. Security groups allow inbound HTTPS from VPC CIDR.

config.alb: internet-facing ALB, default listener rules, no WAF association
config.compute: ECS Fargate task with host path mount, task role has s3:PutObject
config.network: VPC with public subnets, security group allows 443 from 10.0.0.0/8
config.container: runs as root, /var/lib/terraform-provider-artifacts mounted from EFS
